_comment: Indicative body for POST /v1/agents. Field names follow the Gnani knowledge file but were summarised, not copied: if Gnani answers 400, the message names the field to fix. Valid languages/ASR/TTS/LLM come from the config endpoints (fill the TODO values from them).
name: CookSmart Rasoi Sahayak
greeting: नमस्ते {{ cook_name }} जी, मैं रसोई सहायक बोल रही हूँ। क्या आप एक मिनट बात कर सकती हैं?
endMessage: धन्यवाद {{ cook_name }} जी, आपका दिन शुभ हो।
transcriber: TODO: from GET config/transcriber_config (must support hi-IN)
tts: TODO: from GET config/tts_config (must support hi-IN)

postCallExtraction.acknowledged: boolean: she heard and acknowledged the menu
postCallExtraction.reports: list of {type: used_up|remaining|spoiled|low, item: one of the canonical item names, quantity: number or null, unit: g|ml|pcs or null, confirmed: boolean (true ONLY if she said yes to the read-back)}
postCallExtraction.problem: {type: stove|cooker|time|ingredient|none, item: canonical name or null, confirmed: boolean}
postCallExtraction.safety_issue: boolean: gas smell, fire, or someone unwell
